messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the cache-storm postmortem. Need a concrete test/eval plan so this doesn't recur each month. Laying out owners + small milestones.
Hector: Agree. can we prioritize quick wins that block production blips first?
Maya: Yes. fast path: add a daily regression job that runs curated prompts hitting hot prefixes + checks p50/p95 latency + kv hit-rate.
Anya: I'll own the curated prompts. Goal: 120 prompt families across short/long contexts and adversarial prefix churn. ETA: 2026-02-04.
Kai: I'll add kv-hit instrumentation to the perf harness and a replay step for spike patterns. ETA: 2026-01-28.
Ops-Bot: Ticket created: #4710 (daily-regression-job), #4711 (prompts-curation), #4712 (harness-kv-metrics).
Lena: For chaos drills, propose a narrow-scope exercise: "cache-storm-mini" that runs on staging with kill signals to cache managers for 10m and monitors failover. I can draft the runbook.
Hector: ACTION: Hector -> wire alerting on sudden kv miss rate uptick (threshold: +20% over baseline 5m). Ticket #4713. Target: 2026-01-20.
Maya: ACTION: Maya -> add eval entry in repo under evals/cache-storm/ with README, expected_tags, and a `golden_snippets` file (sanitized). Format: jsonl with fields `prompt`, `expected_tags`, `notes`.
Anya: question: do we store full golden outputs? I'd prefer tags + short golden snippets to avoid PII.
Maya: agree, tags + snippets only. add provenance field for synthetic vs real.
Kai: Note: load tests need to simulate client-side backpressure + concurrent streams. I'll add a config knob `concurrency_profile: bursty`.
Lena: I'll draft the drill runbook by 2026-01-24. It will have prechecks, guardrails, and abort criteria.
Ops-Bot: Access request AR-810 created for Kai to get perf-cluster access. Approver: Lena.
Hector: can we also gate deploys with a quick canary that runs 50 queries from the curated prompt set and checks latency/regression?
Maya: yes. plan: canary-run step in CI that samples 0.5% traffic to the new variant for 1h and fails if p95 > baseline+20% or kv-miss increases > 15%.
Anya: I'll version the prompt set and add a changelog in the evals dir so we can trace regressions to prompt changes.
Kai: PR incoming for harness changes. tagging @Maya for review.
Maya: I'll add these tickets to the postmortem action tracker and set weekly check-ins. Please ping if blocked.
Hector: timeline recap: daily job (2026-01-15), kv metrics + harness (2026-01-28), canary automation (2026-01-22), prompt curation (2026-02-04), drill runbook (2026-01-24).
Lena: I'll schedule the drill for a staging window Feb 3. low risk.
Anya: added a sample schema gist: https://redwood/gists/cache-prompt-schema
Ops-Bot: Reminder: standup micro-sync scheduled Thu 10:15.
Maya: thanks all. focus order: daily regression -> canary -> harness metrics -> runbook -> drill. Keep updates here.
Hector: 👍
Kai: 👍
Lena: ✅
